title: auto0.5HP
description: A data pack that forcibly reduces the player's HP to 0.5 and increases the difficulty.
body:
**This data pack may be for advanced users.**

ver-1.0

After adding the world you want to use, enter the /reload command, click the "world" section, and then click the yellow area. The system will then automatically modify the players in that world.

ver-1.1

After adding the world you want to use, load the world. The system will then automatically apply improvements to the players in that world.

**notes**
From version 1.1 onwards, it will work simply by installing data packs/mods into the world, even without op privileges.
This data pack may be for advanced users.



I would like to express my gratitude to Rusk for their cooperation in creating this datapack
